strings: r_c0 has noticed that m_c is using {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} chattering as a form of stimming recently.
m_c has been stimming more often recently.
It seems like m_c can barely stay still as {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/wriggle/wriggles} {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} whole body in excitement for the whole day.
m_c keeps purring to {PRONOUN/m_c/self} as an act of self soothing.
Some of m_c's Clanmates find themselves confused by m_c's running around the camp in small circles, seemingly chasing {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} tail.
